title: Repository non-local optimisation option evaluation
purpose: Evaluate non-local timing optimisation options without adopting external providers, credentials, staging infrastructure, deployment claims, or production readiness claims.
tracksWorkOnlyStatement: This issue tracks work only. It does not define USF semantic authority.

futureAdoptionAuthorityRequired: runtime proof evidence where behaviour is claimed
Linear issue tracking the adoption work only

options.label: Testcontainers for composed service lifecycle timing
options.reasonNotAdopted: Testcontainers may reduce bespoke compose orchestration overhead and improve per-test lifecycle isolation, but adoption would introduce new runtime dependencies, image lifecycle semantics, network lifecycle semantics, and proof expectations outside the bounded local optimisation tranche.
comparisonCriteria: repeatable cold-start and warm-start timing across at least three local runs
service readiness equivalence with the existing composed semantic harness
failure-mode equivalence for unavailable ports, unhealthy services, and teardown errors
developer setup cost and dependency availability impact
evidenceRequirements: validator update proving Testcontainers-specific proof cannot satisfy live-external-provider or production-live claims
rollback path preserving existing compose compatibility

options.label: Remote cache for repeated validation and build work
options.reasonNotAdopted: Remote cache could reduce repeated validation cost, but adoption would require external service trust boundaries, cache-key semantics, credential handling, artifact retention semantics, and false-pass protection that are not authorised in the bounded local tranche.
comparisonCriteria: local no-cache baseline versus cache-hit and cache-miss timing
cache-key completeness for semantic artefacts, validators, package manager lockfiles, generated reports, and environment inputs
fail-closed behaviour for missing, stale, or untrusted cache entries
auditability of cached evidence and generated report provenance
evidenceRequirements: cache-key design document tied to authority references
validator proof that stale or missing remote cache cannot satisfy pass evidence
credential storage and rotation decision before any external cache use
local fallback timing and correctness evidence

options.label: Task graph tooling for affected-run and validation orchestration
options.reasonNotAdopted: Task graph tooling could improve affected-run selection and command scheduling, but adoption would redefine validation orchestration boundaries and requires explicit graph semantics so affected-run remains warn-only until authorised.
comparisonCriteria: graph construction cost versus current direct command timing
fail-closed behaviour when graph metadata is missing or stale
compatibility with current Make and package script entry points
ability to keep affected-run advisory until separate authority promotes it
evidenceRequirements: dependency graph semantics and validator coverage mapping
full validation equivalence evidence for changed-file samples
explicit authority decision before affected-run becomes pass-fail gating

nonGoals: creating staging, deployment, store, or production-live claims
changing affected-run from warn-only to authoritative gating

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: All non-local timing options are explicitly evaluated.
No non-local option is adopted by this bounded tranche.
Each option has comparison criteria and evidence requirements for future adoption.
Provider, environment, staging, deployment, and production-readiness nonclaims are preserved.
A validator enforces the bounded non-adoption posture.
